subject: Post-discovery: technical deep-dive (ML/infra roundtable) — scheduling and agenda

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rao <alex.rao@novacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: technical deep-dive (ML/infra roundtable) — scheduling and agenda

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side:

- Goal for the technical deep-dive: validate NovaCorp's production constraints (latency, throughput, data residency) and walk ML + infra teams through a 60–90 minute runthrough of Redwood's serving runtime, routing/fallback options, and ops/observability hooks.
- Suggested format: 15 min context & deployment constraints, 30–40 min demo of inference paths + KV/prefix caching, 15–30 min Q&A + rollout/next steps.

To make scheduling easy, here are three proposed 60–90 minute slots (PT):
- Tue Jun 8 — 09:00–10:30 PT
- Wed Jun 9 — 13:00–14:30 PT
- Thu Jun 10 — 11:00–12:30 PT

Can you confirm which slot works, and who from NovaCorp will attend (ML lead, infra/ops, security/compliance)? We attached a short post-discovery summary and a draft agenda for reference (see attachments).

If useful, we can also do a 15-minute prep call on the day of the deep-dive (internal + NovaCorp EMs) to align demos and data scope.

Attaching: novacorp-postdiscovery-summary.pdf (1 page), tdx-agenda-draft.docx

Thanks — will loop Ben and Grace once we lock a time so we have the right presenters.

—Chloe

Confirmed for Wed Jun 9 13:00–14:30 PT with a 12:30 PT prep call. Quick internal plan:
- I'll own the demo (13:10–13:40): show baseline latency, KV/prefix cache toggles, and a short stress scenario to demonstrate cache warm-up.
- Grace: can you cover region/failover and how smart routing would look in NovaCorp's multi-region setup (13:40–14:05)?
